legend: The well-known manufacturer of children's construction sets, OLEG, is going through some tough times. For reasons yet to be determined, all factories producing the parts for the sets have stopped. While the situation with the factories is being clarified, the company's management needs to release a new batch of sets, which will have to be assembled from the currently available parts.

There are n$$$n$$$ types of construction parts. For each type i$$$i$$$, the mass mi$$$m_i$$$ and the count ci$$$c_i$$$ of the parts are known. The management wants to assemble as many identical sets as possible, such that the total mass of the parts included in each set is at least mmin$$$m_{\min}$$$ and at most mmax$$$m_{\max}$$$. Two sets are considered identical if the number of parts of each type included in both sets is the same.
Determine the maximum number of sets that can be produced.
input: The first line contains the integers n$$$n$$$, mmin$$$m_{\min}$$$, and mmax$$$m_{\max}$$$ (1≤n≤50$$$1 \le n \le 50$$$, 1≤mmin≤mmax≤104$$$1 \le m_{\min} \le m_{\max} \le 10^4$$$). The next n$$$n$$$ lines contain numbers mi$$$m_i$$$ and ci$$$c_i$$$ for each type i$$$i$$$ (1≤mi≤104$$$1 \le m_i \le 10^4$$$, 1≤ci≤106$$$1 \le c_i \le 10^6$$$, 1≤i≤n$$$1 \le i \le n$$$).
output: Output a single integer — the maximum number of sets that can be produced.
note: In the example, one possible set can be constructed by taking two parts of type 1$$$1$$$ and one part of type 3$$$3$$$. The total mass of the set would be 3+3+7=13$$$3 + 3 + 7 = 13$$$, and from the available parts, a total of 4$$$4$$$ such sets can be assembled.

legend.ai: 知名的儿童拼装玩具制造商 OLEG 正处于艰难时期。由于尚未确定的原因，所有生产拼装玩具零件的工厂都停工了。在调查工厂情况期间，公司管理层需要发布一批新的拼装玩具，而这批玩具必须使用目前可用的零件进行组装。
共有 n$$$n$$$ 种拼装零件。对于每种类型 i$$$i$$$，已知其单个零件的质量 mi$$$m_i$$$ 以及零件数量 ci$$$c_i$$$。管理层希望组装尽可能多套完全相同的拼装玩具，使得每套玩具中所包含零件的总质量至少为 mmin$$$m_{\min}$$$ 且至多为 mmax$$$m_{\max}$$$。如果两套玩具中每种类型零件的数量都相同，则认为这两套玩具相同。
确定能够制作出的套数的最大值。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——能够制作出的套数的最大值。

note.ai: 在该样例中，可以取两个类型为 1$$$1$$$ 的部件和一个类型为 3$$$3$$$ 的部件组成一套。该套的总质量为 3+3+7=13$$$3 + 3 + 7 = 13$$$，利用现有部件总共可以组装出 4$$$4$$$ 套这样的套。
